requirements.summary: A gated clock pulse is passed whole or not at all, whenever the enable changes: while the clock is high or while it is low. No edge appears while the gate is closed.
With both clocks running, the switch changes in either direction without a short pulse and without both clocks enabled at once, also when the select changes while the output is high.
A stopped target leaves the output low until it runs again. A stopped selected clock cannot be left; the reset recovers the switch.
The odd divider has a period of DIV input periods and equal high and low times, also after a reset in the middle of a pulse.
